datePolicy: Original research and cited source access recorded on 2026-11-06. Localization on 2026-11-06 used retained material only: no external research, source refresh or confirmed 2027 prices. RSPCA anxiety guidance was updated 2022-09-06; SDCH FAQ was updated 2026-10-06. Access dates do not establish publication dates; undated tariffs remain undated.
uncertainties: Household income, debt, savings and surplus unknown; no unconditional affordability conclusion. Emergency cash is outside annual allocations and monthly targets.

48 paid-care weeks assume owner leave or another arrangement for the rest. A $500 backup pot is not a four-week boarding quote. Walk-only scenarios require proven individual alone-time tolerance; daycare is not suitable for every dog.
Dog Haus day limited to eight hours; daycare transport and extra-hour prices unavailable and excluded. Kip introductory rate is not a recurring tariff. Provider capacity and 2027 prices unconfirmed.

Insurance examples come from one insurer, only one in Sydney. Cover endpoints cannot be matched, fee inclusion uncertain, and the $1,200 premium is an allowance. Actual eligibility, exclusions and premium need checking; routine care is separate.

Rental rules follow retained Fair Trading guidance, not independently inspected legislation. Existing-tenancy 28-day challenge and new-tenancy 21-day temporary-presence deadlines are distinct. Actual landlord and required strata permissions remain unresolved.

Individual adoption fees and animal availability may change. Bunny, Asher, Stormy and Norman are cost/suitability examples, not matches recommended for this couple. Adult does not mean toilet-trained or comfortable alone.
Nil-fee lifetime registration depends on rescue eligibility and is not exemption from registration. Included implantation is assumed, not a universal free microchip tariff.

Food quantity and parasite products are costing examples, not feeding or medicine advice. Current vaccination history, individual diet, parasite coverage, dental needs and behaviour care can change the budget.
Fostering is not necessarily free, short or a guaranteed route to adoption. Some food/vet-payment terms remain unconfirmed; Monika requires refundable deposit and may need months to a year.

Original public-source research had automatic existing managed-browser fallbacks, with cleanliness not independently certified. Failed later fetches do not replace earlier successful retrievals. No external lookup or browser was used for this new guide.
editingContract: English-only scenario draft with source-supported FAQ. No bilingual numeric/date/URL or table-cell parity claim applies because no Chinese page was authored. No ratings, Review or AggregateRating. Source-run files and shared inventory/build files unchanged; no build or publication.
